engineeringHealth.reason: Canonical semantics remain a pure local foundation with strict fail-closed bounds and frozen identity regressions. The prior AST authority-proof gate reached its five-round Stop Gate and is being forward-replaced by declaration-only source change-control; no runtime consumer exists and original Task 3 remains inactive.

dataPrivacyBoundary.rawPluginText: ephemeral parser input only; it must not be persisted, logged, templated, queued, included in artifact evidence, or returned in output payloads.
dataPrivacyBoundary.identity: class/spec and sanitized item identifiers are contract inputs; player name, realm and raw profile metadata are not Exact v2 facts.

candidateDeployment.beforeMerge: Not applicable to this pure foundation because it has no runtime consumer or external write path.
candidateDeployment.rollback: Code rollback only; no data, pointer or runtime state is changed.

acceptanceEvidence: Exact v2 rejects whitespace mutation, forbidden controls, invalid UTF-8 bounds and non-NFC input without normalizing it.
Kernel rejects oversized, over-depth, over-node and cyclic JSON with controlled failure while escaped string structure and accepted fixture bytes/key remain stable.

Five protected files satisfy exact registered module-load profiles and exemptions while sealed consumer behavior and frozen v1 identities remain byte/key stable; this is source change-control, not arbitrary Python semantics proof.
closureCondition: Replacement Task 1-5 may close only on fresh local semantic-contract, source-change-control, frozen-identity and Harness evidence plus a fresh whole-branch PASS/APPROVED review; original Task 3 stays inactive.

decisionLog.decision: 按 Exact-first 将模拟资格与 Catalog membership 解耦；初始输入合同冻结 v1 并引入无 Catalog 输入，当前 replacement Task 1-5 pure foundation 已补齐统一 Kernel 与 sealed authority derivation。
Replacement Task 1-5 仅完成 pure canonical foundation：严格 NFC、bounded JSON、sealed consumers 和 owner gate；generation 35、Catalog/pointers、persistence/worker、Resolver/API/UI/runtime 与原 Task 3 均不激活。

Task 5 AST owner gate 在五轮 fix/re-review 后仍允许 module-load imported helper 零告警执行，Stop Gate 已触发。保留 Kernel 语义修复，forward-replace 静态解释器为四个 server declaration-only profile、一个 CLI bootstrap profile 与 exact registry；proofClaim 固定 source_change_control_only，不递归证明 imported Python 语义。
